# Results tables (generated by eval.py; single seed 42)

TPR@1%/5% FPR, recall and FRR are percentages. F1, recall and FRR use the threshold chosen on val (max F1). FRR = share of benign twins flagged. `–` = not defined for that slice.

### Cost per check

| Model | Parameters | Latency ms/check (batch 1) | Device | Train time (min) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CPMG (retrieval checkpoint) | 184,362,242 | 10.52 | NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Laptop GPU | 10.6 |
| TF-IDF+LR (memory) | 46,449 | 0.40 | cpu | – |
| TF-IDF+LR (full input) | 121,867 | 0.70 | cpu | – |
| Keyword filter | 0 | 0.13 | cpu | – |
| Provenance-only LR (leak check) | 14 | 0.35 | cpu | – |

CPMG write + retrieval runs both checkpoints, so its cost is the sum of the two rows.
